firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently visited Lisboa starts and takes the Starting Player marker.
clarifications: Play goes clockwise from that player.
Starting positions on the Influence Track depend on that order.
internalEvidence: The ©2017 Eagle-Gryphon Games English rulebook gives the most recent Lisboa visitor, Starting Player marker, clockwise play, and order-based Influence positions on page 5. uncertainty: No tie procedure is given for equally recent visitors.
